description: Implementation of string substitution functions and argument formatting in the Abseil C++ library, including functions for substituting placeholders in strings and formatting arguments as hex or decimal.

classes.name: absl::Arg
classes.description: Represents an argument for string substitution, supporting various formats such as raw pointers, hex, and decimal.

methods.name: absl::substitute_internal::SubstituteAndAppendArray
methods.description: Performs string substitution by replacing placeholders with provided arguments.

methods.name: absl::Arg::Arg(const void* value)
methods.description: Constructs an Arg object from a pointer, representing it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: absl::Arg::Arg(Hex hex)
methods.description: Constructs an Arg object from a Hex value, formatting it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: absl::Arg::Arg(Dec dec)
methods.description: Constructs an Arg object from a Dec value, formatting it as a decimal string.
